name: RealWebAssist
description: RealWebAssist is a benchmark for evaluating AI agents on long-horizon web assistance tasks involving sequential instruction following with real-world users. It focuses on reasoning about user intent, tracking mental states, understanding ambiguous instructions, and grounding tasks to GUI actions across multiple websites.
reputation: A newly introduced benchmark for long-horizon web assistance agents, with early-stage adoption mainly in research papers on agentic web interaction.
notes: Dataset collected from real users; highlights challenges in understanding ambiguous instructions and grounding to GUI elements.
